ssv-silver-gull-settlements.keybind.open: Show the town or city the crew are standing in, and the interesting places they can walk into.
ssv-silver-gull-settlements.settings.wan: Background NPCs drift around inside settlement interiors. Pauses automatically during combat and when nobody is looking at the scene.
ssv-silver-gull-settlements.settings.cha: Occasional one-line speech bubbles from the locals.
ssv-silver-gull-settlements.settings.aut: While a combat is running in a settlement interior, hide the Leave button and stop the doorway from sending anyone back to the hub.
ssv-silver-gull-settlements.settings.wan: How often wandering NPCs take a step. Lower is livelier and chattier on the network.
